1	# D.110c-0c1b bounded source/architecture audit
2	
3	Audit anchor: signed/pushed commit
4	`90a06a1aae79d408a1c2c6b014dae1a99daf866d`, tree
5	`8a85703957dc6e4eb4f8351de008cebc4be02348`.
6	
7	## Demonstrated defect
8	
9	`packages/node/src/v3-live.ts::issueOneVertex()` returns from
10	`issuer.issue()` normally returns only after
11	`DurableIssuanceStore.transactIssue()` has committed the exact issued record
12	and pending outbox row. All failures from `committedFailure()` therefore occur
13	after durable issuance. There is also one pre-return ambiguous arm: both real
14	issuance stores can commit and then throw exact
15	`ISSUANCE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` when the bounded terminal readback is unavailable.
16	The surrounding catch and `committedFailure()` set
17	`operationAdmissionHalted` only when an optional operation-policy reservation
18	exists. Even when they do set the flag, neither
19	`creatorCloseRegistration()` nor the queued `stageClosedBlueprintEpoch()`
20	checks it. A close can consequently fold/capture a graph that omits a durable
21	issued row.
22	
23	The queue ordering makes the dynamic omission deterministic. Creator snapshot
24	staging sets `blueprintClosing` synchronously, then queues
25	`stageClosedBlueprintEpoch()` behind all earlier registration tasks. If an
26	earlier issue has committed but its journal append then fails, the issue task
27	sets the recovery-required flag and completes; the queued fold runs next and
28	currently ignores that flag.
29	
30	## Existing recovery owner
31	
32	`recoverV3LiveReplica()` already owns exact reconciliation. Its outbox scan:
33	
34	- pages the real issuance store and point-reads the matching issued record;
35	- requires byte-exact issued/outbox equality;
36	- authenticates current/displaced authority, signature, object, epoch,
37	  anchor, author, sequence, operation, dependencies, ACL and terminal order;
38	- reserves the operation policy;
39	- appends the local-issued journal row, accepting idempotence only when the
40	  graph already contains the same authenticated vertex;
41	- appends the graph and retained application vertex exactly once; and
42	- commits the recovered operation reservation or rejects activation.
43	
44	The retained E5-01 recovery test already demonstrates the adjacent
45	post-journal ambiguous case rebuilding the reservation exactly once. No new
46	durable marker, schema, API, wire field, dependency, authority rule or store
47	operation is necessary for this defect.
48	
49	## Selected minimal repair
50	
51	This is composition/orchestration, not new product data:
52	
53	1. Every `committedFailure()` after `issuer.issue()` returned a durable commit
54	   unconditionally sets the existing `operationAdmissionHalted`
55	   recovery-required flag. The surrounding catch also sets it when the thrown
56	   error has exact code `ISSUANCE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, independent of whether an
57	   operation admission policy is installed. Definitely pre-transaction
58	   signer and capacity failures retain their existing release/retry behavior.
59	2. `creatorCloseRegistration()` refuses to mint a close registration while
60	   that flag is set.
61	3. `stageClosedBlueprintEpoch()` rechecks the same flag after the registration
62	   queue barrier, so a close handle bound before an in-flight issue cannot fold
63	   after that issue reports a committed failure.
64	
65	The recovery flag remains in-memory and conservative. It does not purport to
66	prove reconciliation. Deactivation plus genuine recovery is the only path
67	that creates a fresh registration with the flag clear, and activation occurs
68	only after the existing authenticated outbox/journal reconciliation succeeds.
69	
70	## Rejected alternatives
71	
72	- In-process close-time outbox repair: duplicates the recovery authority and
73	  application pipeline inside creator close and widens failure ordering.
74	- Skipping or retiring the orphan at close: treats durable issuance as
75	  authority, loses a signed operation, breaks the dense sequence frontier, and
76	  can hide unpublished work.
77	- Deleting or marking the row published: falsifies durable issuance/outbox
78	  truth and publication custody.
79	- Adding an issuance outcome marker or transaction spanning two stores: not
80	  required because the existing recovery scan already reconciles the exact
81	  durable row; would introduce schema/store-contract work.
